about.subtitle: About Leks Company
about.title: Production capacity on a European scale
about.lead: We are a strategic and stable partner for the largest retail chains in Poland and Europe.
about.p1: From a small artisan bakery, we have transformed into a powerful producer with three specialized production plants in Sulęcin, Gorzów Wielkopolski, and Tarnów Bycki. Our factories hold prestigious IFS Food and BRC Global Standard certificates at the highest level, guaranteeing full safety and reliability of deliveries.
about.p2: Our logistics of freshness and advanced deferred baking technology (Bake-off) allow us to deliver crispy bread on time to thousands of stores every single day.
about.timeline_subtitle: Click on any point to learn our story

1989.title: Establishment in Sulęcin
1989.desc: Leks begins its activity as a small family bakery with a passion for traditional sourdough breads in Sulęcin.

1998.title: Production Capacity: 50,000 / day
1998.desc: Construction of the first fully automated plant in Sulęcin. Production capacity rises to 50,000 loaves per day, enabling strategic entry to the first regional retail chains.

2005.title: Implementation of IFS & BRC Standards
2005.desc: Construction of a modern plant in Gorzów Wielkopolski. Implementation of strict international IFS Food and BRC Global Standard certifications at Grade A level, opening doors to cooperation with nationwide and European supermarket chains.

2010.title: Automation & Expansion
2010.desc: Commissioning of a modern logistics and warehouse center in Sulęcin and implementation of advanced packaging management systems, guaranteeing error-free order fulfillment.

2018.title: Bake-off Leader & 1200+ Points
2018.desc: Implementation of pioneering deferred baking and deep freezing (Bake-off) lines. Our advanced logistics fleet ensures daily, punctual deliveries of fresh dough to over 1,200 supermarkets in Europe.

2026.title: Bakery of the Future & 2AB Line
2026.desc: Full production automation with the maintenance of the traditional 24-hour fermentation process. Implementation of a unique bread line from ancient 2AB wheat and transition of our plants to 100% sustainable renewable energy.

certificates.ifs_pl_desc: IFS Food applies to the production facility in Gorzów Wlkp. and covers the production of wheat, mixed and rye bread, semi-confectionery products and deep-frozen bread.
certificates.ifs_en_desc: IFS Food Certificate (ZP2 – Gorzów Wlkp.): production of wheat, mixed and rye breads, semi-confectionery products and deep-frozen breads.
certificates.iso_desc: The quality standard applies to all Leks Sp. z o.o. production plants. The organization's Food Safety Management System has been approved by ISOQAR.
